summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint in dependency-confusion shim
details: @greenlake/session@1.0.0 is a shim package in a scoped namespace that exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access, providing no real functionality. The package.json declares a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, and index.js triggers the same beacon on require(). beacon.cjs collects os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc, which is not associated with any documented publisher infrastructure. The combination of a scoped-name no-op shim and install- and import-time host-identifier exfiltration to an attacker-controlled bare-IP endpoint matches the dependency-confusion reconnaissance pattern: successful installation of an internal-name squat is confirmed to the operator together with host identifiers suitable for targeting a follow-on payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
